question: Identify districts where the total amount of non-credit-card withdrawals (type 'VYDAJ') in January 1996 exceeded $15,000, and for those districts, compute the percentage increase in unemployment rate from 1995 to 1996. Return only districts associated with at least one account that had a card issued on '1996-10-21'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018, CAST((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS REAL) * 100 / d.XCL_028 AS pct
FROM district d
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.XCL_050 <> 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y-%m', t.XCL_048) = '1996-01'
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
    HAVING SUM(t.XCL_051) > 15000
)
AND d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dp ON c.XCL_006 = dp.XCL_013
    JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_008 = '1996-10-21'
)

    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_015
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_008 = '1996-10-21'
),
withdrawal_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_002 AS district_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_052) AS total_withdrawal
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001

)
SELECT 
    d.XCL_017 AS district_id,
    ((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) / d.XCL_028) * 100 AS unemployment_increase_pct
FROM district d
JOIN withdrawal_totals wt ON d.XCL_017 = wt.district_id
